read: CNERGY remains above both its 20-day (8.99) and 50-day (8.63) SMAs after a strong 20-day run of +21.17%, but today's session printed a sharp -6.13% drop on a 4.37x volume surge, pulling price back to 9.96 while still ~6.5% below the 20-day high. RSI14 at 63.8 is elevated but not extreme, and the heavy-volume reversal candle after an extended rally is the notable technical event this cycle.
